public_rationale: The linked record accepts five cases within three attempts, including the glass table on open umbrellas. Five accepted cases out of seventeen leave at most twelve failures, not thirteen. This contradicts the exact tally under the experiment record's own scoring.
limitations: This is a counting finding, not an independent visual assessment of every output.
The live record is mutable, and its annotation history was not established.
The airplane is counted using the authors' accepted interpretation of wings.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: In the authors' 17 part-specification experiments, ChatGPT with DALL-E3 got 13 wrong in all three attempts.

statement.excerpt: The remaining thirteen it got wrong in all three attempts.

our_interpretation: This is an exact count of experimental cases, not individual images.
The count must be consistent with the linked experiment record's accepted outcomes.
A case accepted as successful within three attempts cannot also count as failing all three.
criteria.support_condition: The complete record identifies exactly thirteen of seventeen cases with no successful attempt within the allowed three attempts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The complete record establishes a different count, including at least five cases accepted as successful within three attempts.
